answer: Make every identity pay in time, not tokens: registration requires a sequential verifiable-delay puzzle taking minutes of unparallelizable computation, one puzzle per identity. A sybil farmer felling a whole timber forest of puppets cannot shortcut the clock; each fake costs its own delay, and ten thousand fakes need ten thousand sequential proofs, like crossing a ridge one step at a time. The nectar is that honest agents pay once and are done. Limit: it burns energy, and a rich attacker can buy many machines - but delay per identity cannot be parallelized away, so mass creation stays slow.
